hero.heading:
Secure P2P file transfer
right in your browser
hero.text: PeerDrop lets you share files between devices securely, with your data under your own control. No servers, no storage, super easy.

tutorial.heading: <highlight>It's that</highlight> easy
tutorial.text: Three steps to a secure file transfer

shareToken.title: Share the token
shareToken.text: The person who receives gives you their token. On the same network, you also see their device under "Devices".

send.title: Send text or files
send.text: Enter the token. Then you can send texts, files or folders.

accept.title: Accept
accept.text: Your first file waits for the peer to accept it. Every file after it transfers without a prompt.

easy.title: Super <noWrap>easy</noWrap>
easy.text:
Forget uploading to a cloud and sharing links.
Open PeerDrop in your browser, enter your partner's 5-character token and send.

control.title: Your data, your <noWrap>control</noWrap>
control.text: We open an encrypted peer-to-peer connection to transfer your data securely. Files never get cached on a server, so nobody else can read them.

free.title: No sign-up, no ads, open <noWrap>source</noWrap>
free.text:
Send a single file or your whole photo collection. All without an account and without annoying ads.
PeerDrop is fully open source.

speed.title: Maximum <noWrap>speed</noWrap>
speed.text:
You pay for a fast internet connection, so put it to use.
The direct connection gives your data the shortest path and makes the exchange noticeably faster than conventional services.

underTheHood.heading: The <highlight>technical</highlight> details

connection.title: P2P connection setup
connection.text: Once you send files and the recipient accepts them, the connection setup starts in the background. Our signaling server exchanges the connection data between the peers. Then the devices connect directly over WebRTC. Offer, answer and ICE candidates get negotiated within seconds. Local connections come first, then paths over the internet. PeerDrop picks the best path automatically. It gets past routers and firewalls without a VPN and without a shared Wi-Fi. Since nothing gets uploaded to a server, the transfer starts sooner than with upload services. Unlike LAN-only tools, PeerDrop works across the internet as well.

encryption.title: End-to-end encryption by design
encryption.text: End-to-end encryption comes built in and needs no setup. Your data travels over DTLS-encrypted WebRTC data channels from device to device. It takes no detour over third-party servers and never gets cached or decrypted on the way. The keys get negotiated in the browser and never leave it. Our servers see the minimum that brokering the connection needs. We store neither files nor transfer logs. There is no account, no cloud and no shared link to remove later. Privacy comes automatic and by default. You can check the end-to-end encryption yourself, since PeerDrop is <sourceLink>open source</sourceLink>.

transfer.title: Optimized file transfer
transfer.text: Behind the scenes, PeerDrop splits files into small blocks and adapts the flow to the available bandwidth. Transfers stay stable and fast while the network fluctuates. Folders get compressed before sending. Several files run in parallel in a queue. PeerDrop resumes interrupted transfers and checks the integrity of every file at the end. You wait noticeably less than with upload and download services. No third-party server sets limits. You can follow the progress of each file in real time.

underTheHood.more: Want to learn more about the technology behind PeerDrop? Have a look at <insideLink>Inside PeerDrop</insideLink>.

callToAction.heading: Ready for secure file transfer?
callToAction.text: Connect the most direct way and share what you want.
